title: Haunt Loop
description:
Guide Nullie, the ghost of a null pointer, through levels that look trivial and are absolutely not. Floors drop, spikes pop, the exit runs away, and the spec changes the moment you learn it.
A rage platformer about developer pain. Every death teaches you something. Mostly humility.
controls: Left/Right or A/D move, Space/W/Up jump (hold for higher), R restart, P or Esc pause, M mute. On phones: on-screen left/right pad, JUMP, pause and restart buttons.

provenance.notes: Built in Claude Code with Opus 5.5, from a human-chosen concept (a Level Devil-style rage platformer) and design answers (character, art style, taunt tone, touch support). All art and sound are procedural. Levels are verified beatable by recorded-input replays in tools/verify-levels.mjs. Screenshots are real frames from bot-driven (Playwright keyboard) play against arcade dev. First release ships levels 1-6; 7-12 are planned.
